scope: Coverage-guided robustness of the public APIs (fuzz/, ADR 0003-0005, 0009, 0010). Clause 7.3.8.2 (stream extent, Table 5) and 7.3.10 were verified in the locally supplied ISO 32000-2:2020 EC3 text; the other requirements are project policy.

requirements.status: nine cargo-fuzz targets; every input ends in a value or a structured error with well-formed tags; strict mode reports no repairs
requirements.gaps: Routine runs are 30 s per target; no sustained campaign on dedicated hardware, no coverage report per crate.

requirements.status: every target runs under reduced Limits with a 10 s time limit and a 2 GiB memory limit per input
requirements.gaps: Limits bound work per operation, not process memory; libFuzzer's limits are the only process-level bound.

requirements.status: decoded samples match image sizes and bit depths, filter output caps hold, glyph codes cover decoded strings, tiles equal the whole page (ADR 0004), and host responses follow PROTOCOL.md
requirements.gaps: No differential comparison with other engines.

requirements.status: every minimized finding in fuzz/regressions/ is replayed on stable Rust through the fuzz drivers; unfixed findings are listed explicitly and fail once fixed
an indirect /Length that refers to its own stream, or two streams whose lengths refer to each other, ends in a structured error
